integrated_multimodal_description: The target video is in the style of a 1990s multi-camera sitcom, shot on studio video with warm, even, shadowless lighting. [Shot 1] A wide shot frames a living room set: a sagging olive-green couch centre frame in front of a brick wall with a window onto a painted city backdrop. A heavyset man in his mid 40s with a shaved head, in an open gray flannel shirt, sits at the right end of the couch reading a magazine and does not look up. A wiry man in his early 30s with short curly dark hair, in a mustard-yellow sweater vest, strides in from frame left holding an empty ice cream carton, stops beside the couch and turns it upside down to show it is empty. The wiry man (S1), a fast, nasal, high-pitched male tenor voice, tight with disbelief, says <d>[English] Okay. Who finished the pistachio?</d> The heavyset man keeps reading. A live studio audience laughs warmly as the carton turns over. The camera holds a static wide shot throughout.

overall_soundscape: A bright, close television-studio room tone. Quick footsteps on a hollow stage floor as the wiry man enters, the papery rattle of the empty carton as it turns over, a soft page turn from the couch, and a warm burst of live studio-audience laughter that begins as the carton flips and settles under the end of the shot.
